victoryPresentation.title: Victory. Somehow.
victoryPresentation.subtitle: All four corners. One Final Core. A remarkably indirect way to finish a to-do list.
paragraphs: I've now asked you to do everything I wanted this game to offer: tame the corners, connect the world, and persuade a very large factory to cooperate. I hope you had fun along the way. Thank you for playing.
If you didn't, you're welcome to mod NODE until it's actually fun. I've done the difficult part: leaving room for improvement.
Still need more? Perhaps visit a planet. Or two. Launch a few rockets. I'm told this is how small factory projects remain small.
Alternatively, sign up with a very large company, travel to a perfectly good planet, and extract its resources. There will probably be a form confirming how satisfied you are.
victoryPresentation.continuationNote: Your factory and progress are preserved. Keep building, keep improving, or just watch it work.
victoryPresentation.buttonSubtext: Optimization is now a personal problem.
victoryPresentation.appearance: charcoal and steel, warm gold glow, faceted Final Core, four orbit points, slow halo with reduced-motion alternative
